sources.snippet: Fine-tuning a small open coder LLM for Verilog/SystemVerilog code generation, evaluated by functional correctness (Verilator compile + testbench pass@1), served through an auto-detected MLX (Apple Silicon) or vLLM (CUDA) backend.

sources.title: henil08/verilog-coder-7b-lora · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: On VerilogEval this fine-tune scores below its base model (23.7% vs 31.4% with the published prompts). Fine-tuning on OpenRTLSet's real-world modules and LLM-written descriptions improved held-out OpenRTLSet modules but cost accuracy on VerilogEval's textbook-style problems; for that style of task the base model is the better choice.

sources.title: From code LLMs to specialized small models · aiXcoder
sources.snippet: Born at Peking University's Institute of Software Engineering, aiXcoder builds six enterprise coding agents, specialized small code models and the Enterprise Hub control platform — deployed fully on-premise in telecom, finance, aerospace and nuclear.
